text:
samir: heads-up, canary promo is on hold. build-wheel-staging job failed when pulling a wheel from the shared cache. deploy-bot posted the job failure.
deploy-bot: [automated] Promo hold applied to canary-2026-03-21. job=build-wheel-staging-237 exit=1 reason=artifact-missing
samir: logs -> `ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement redwood-core==1.14.0` from pip install. wheel path expected: `s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/wheels/redwood_core-1.14.0-py3-none-any.whl`
maria: is this the cache TTL eviction we saw last week? could be the cache index got trimmed and uploader didn't reupload.
jordan: filing theory: cache index stamp rotated during the artifact upload window, so some runners saw the new index (no wheel) while others still had pointers to old keys. can you paste the deploy-bot artifact manifest snippet?
samir: manifest excerpt:
```
- key: wheels/redwood_core-1.14.0.whl
  etag: "abc123"
  uploaded: 1718999000
- key: wheels/redwood_core-1.13.2.whl
  etag: "def456"
  uploaded: 1718990000
```
elena: interesting — upload time looks fine. but the registry GC job ran at 1719000005 yesterday and evicted unreferenced objects. maybe the upload didn't mark the new wheel as pinned.
maria: is there a simple unblock? can we reupload the missing wheel and retry the job, or do we pin the previous image to unblock promo?
jordan: reupload + retry is ideal but might take >15m. given release window, I'd prefer pin to last-good image for the canary and then do reupload without blocking the promo.
release-manager: timeline: we have the 4pm cut. if pin is quick (under 5m), do that and continue. Otherwise postpone cut by 1 hour.
ci-bot: quick commands: `aws s3 cp /tmp/redwood_core-1.14.0.whl s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/wheels/ --acl private && deploybot retry build-wheel-staging-237`
maria: can someone with upload creds run that? I don't have write access to that bucket.
samir: I can do the reupload now and trigger a retry. trying now.
samir: (runs) `aws s3 cp redwood_core-1.14.0.whl s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/wheels/ && aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket redwood-ci-artifacts --key wheels/redwood_core-1.14.0.whl --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=protected,Value=true}]'`
samir: upload done, tagging applied, re-triggering build: `deploybot retry build-wheel-staging-237`
deploy-bot: retry queued for build-wheel-staging-237. runner=gh-runner-12
maria: nice. I'll watch the job.
(10m later)
ci-bot: build-wheel-staging-237 started on gh-runner-12
ci-bot: pip output: `Successfully installed redwood-core-1.14.0`
ci-bot: build-wheel-staging-237 exit=0
deploy-bot: canary promo resumed automatically after job success. Promo status: passing -> queuing promote.
release-manager: great. will proceed with canary promote at 15:18 UTC. leaving a note in the release doc about transient artifact GC causing a missing wheel; follow-up: add manifest pin on upload.
elena: created ticket INF-412: ensure uploader marks objects as pinned/protected before GC window, and add retry hooks to uploader.
jordan: also adding a short-runbook to eng-releases: if promo hold due to missing artifact, attempt reupload+tag, then retry; fallback to manual pin to previous image if upload not possible.
release-manager: thanks all. marking thread resolved once promote completes. :thumbsup:
